Callout.Name: Break-In at the Marina
Callout.Message: Break-in reported at a marina office.

Script.Line: There is a torch on in the office and it is not mine.
I look after the boats, not the office. I have no key to the office.
Two of them went in through the window about ten minutes ago.

Lines.Approach: The office window is in and there is a torch moving about inside.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
